# chipColor

## Summary

The display color of one Munsell chip as an `[r, g, b]` triple in `[0, 1]`, from hue `h` (fraction in `[0, 1)`), value `v` (0–10), and chroma `c`. Chips with chroma below 0.5 render as the neutral gray trunk (a slightly cool gray whose lightness tracks value); chromatic chips map through `lerpWrapDeg` and `hslToRgb`.

## Import

```javascript
import { chipColor } from '../utils/munsell';
```

## Usage

```javascript
let rgb = chipColor(0.7, 3, 12); // a deep purple-blue chip
```
